name: new-term-radar
description: Three skills that find the names of new AI models, products and repositories as they surface, and size the search terms behind them with Google Ads volume and Google Trends.

aisa_api_key.title: AIsa API key
aisa_api_key.description: Handles social discovery, model calls and the fallback search route. recent_leads works without it. A key: https://go.aisa.one/yansen-zhu (referral link)

dataforseo_login.title: DataForSEO API login (optional)
dataforseo_login.description: Optional direct route for Google Trends, Ads volume, SERP, KD, WHOIS and backlinks. Set with the API password.

dataforseo_password.title: DataForSEO API password (optional)
dataforseo_password.description: The API password from DataForSEO API Access, not the dashboard password. Set with the API login.

goanyapi_api_key.title: GoAnyAPI API key (optional)
goanyapi_api_key.description: Optional: what people searched together with each name, and one country's daily Trends series. A key: https://goanyapi.com
